bibl.title: The Iconography of Kantharos Cups on Roman Period Egyptian Coffins from Deir El-Bahari.
bibl.seg: Sara El-Sayed Kitat, The Iconography of Kantharos Cups on Roman Period Egyptian Coffins from Deir El-Bahari.
bibl.note: A group of Roman mummy masks was discovered in Deir el-Bahari and represents the deceased holding the kantharos wine cup in the right hand. Throws the light on this vessel sufficiently to be used as the basis to question the purpose behind portraying the kantharos cup in this group of masks.
